name: purification-decline-second-curse-clears-the-staged-copies
notes: Purification: discard one of two Curse cards from the lineage, decline the second. The staged temp-zone copies must be cleared; declining used to skip PurificationCurse2 (which clears them), leaving a display-only copy of the Curse in the temp zone.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. PurificationCurse1/2 (the 'choose up to two Curse cards from your champion's lineage' picks) were queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining a pick skipped the handler that clears the temp-zone copies the picks are made from; the copies stayed behind. Fix: both queue sites pass dontSkipOnPass and the handlers consume the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
